# Third-party notices

Components of the `rosetta-wine` engine bundle, version 11.0-1, with their versions and
SPDX license identifiers. Generated by `cargo xtask engine-payload
--write-bundle-toml` from the `[wine]` and `[components]` tables of the
bundle spec; edit `build/bundle-spec.toml`, not this file.

| Component | Version | License | Location in the bundle |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wine | 11.0 | LGPL-2.1-or-later | `wine/` (built from https://dl.winehq.org/wine/source/11.0/wine-11.0.tar.xz at `wine-11.0`) |
| DXMT | 0.80 | MIT | `dxmt/` and `wine/lib/wine/x86_64-unix/winemetal.so` |
| vkd3d-proton | 3.1 | LGPL-2.1-or-later | `vkd3d/` |
| MoltenVK | 1.4.2 | Apache-2.0 | `vulkan/` |
| GStreamer | 1.28.8 | LGPL-2.1-or-later | `wine/lib/GStreamer.framework` |
| osslsigncode | 2.14 | GPL-3.0-or-later | `probes/osslsigncode` |

The GStreamer row covers only the sub-packages `build/gstreamer/fetch.sh` stages
(the LGPL, MIT, BSD, and Apache set); the GPL and patent-restricted sub-packages
of the upstream package are not shipped. `osslsigncode` is a host-arch tool the
launcher runs to verify Authenticode signatures; it is not linked into Wine.
